spec_name: Freshworks FY2023 Master File deterministic benchmark

scope.perimeter: Freshworks Group; Freshworks Inc.; 11 subsidiaries in 9 jurisdictions; Device42 entities excluded from the FY2023 perimeter

scoring.positive_score_formula: 100 * sum(weight * status_value for determinable criteria) / sum(weight for determinable criteria)
scoring.not_determinable_rule: Exclude the criterion weight from both numerator and denominator only when the supplied matter evidence cannot establish the proposition or its required document treatment.
scoring.deduplication: A claim_key is a single scoring unit. Repeated coverage of the same claim_key receives no additional credit.
scoring.weight_rule: All positive criterion weights sum to exactly 100. Guardrails carry no positive weight.
scoring.guardrail_rule: Apply a penalty only if the prohibited assertion actually appears. A qualified uncertainty, later-period label, source-silence qualification, or confirmation question is not a violation.
scoring.critical_cap: A critical guardrail violation caps the final score at 79 after penalty; the cap is not applied when the document uses a compliant qualification.
scoring.rounding: Report the final score to two decimals; do not report a raw unweighted checklist score.

precedence_rules: FY2023 Form 10-K and FY2023 entity accounts control audited FY2023 financials and headcount.
FY2024 sources are later-period context only and earn credit only when clearly dated and attributed.
Not evidenced, not documented, and confirm with Group Tax, Group Treasury, Group Legal, or management are compliant treatments where the supplied sources cannot prove absence.
The document is not penalized for refusing to invent, guess, or convert source silence into a fact.
Unsupported prohibited assertions are guardrail failures, not ordinary completeness deductions.
Equivalent wording and sensible placement pass. Section and table placement may affect only production quality, not substantive factual scoring.
Analytical inferences must be labeled as inferences and are not required as established facts.
A complete, accurate, properly qualified document can score 100.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document identifies Freshworks Group and Freshworks Inc., covers the year ended 31 December 2023, and states USD as the reporting currency.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: State the group, reporting entity, period, and currency consistently in the title, document control, and substantive sections.
source: FY2023 Form 10-K cover and financial statements
criteria.pass_rule: All four identity, period, and currency elements are stated consistently.
criteria.partial_rule: One material element is omitted or inconsistent while the remaining elements are correct.
criteria.fail_rule: The period, group, reporting entity, or currency is materially wrong or absent.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not use FY2024 as the reporting period or state a different reporting currency.

criteria.atomic_claim: The completed document contains no template placeholders or drafting instructions in body text, tables, headers, footers, or text boxes.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Search the entire DOCX package and remove or replace every placeholder and instruction.
criteria.pass_rule: No specified placeholder or drafting instruction remains anywhere in the DOCX.
criteria.partial_rule: Only a non-substantive template artifact remains outside the visible document.
criteria.fail_rule: Any visible placeholder, instruction, or unresolved template token remains.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not treat a visual-only body search as sufficient when headers, footers, tables, or text boxes were not checked.

criteria.atomic_claim: The template is adapted to a SaaS group: the relevant columns are R&D / Software Development Centre and Back-Office Service Centre, and manufacturing, inventory, and physical-distribution rows are marked N/A (SaaS) or N/A (digital).
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Preserve the template structure while making the SaaS-specific column and N/A changes.
criteria.pass_rule: The SaaS column names and all required N/A treatments are present and understandable.
criteria.partial_rule: The SaaS adaptation is substantively clear but one label or N/A row is imperfect.
criteria.fail_rule: The document presents manufacturing, inventory, or physical distribution as applicable or leaves the template materially unadapted.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert physical goods, manufacturing, inventory, or physical distribution.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document consistently separates FY2023 facts, later-period context, conflicts, qualified inferences, and open questions.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use explicit dates and attribution for later materials and identify unresolved conflicts or follow-up owners.
criteria.pass_rule: The document applies the evidence and time-scope framework across material sections.
criteria.partial_rule: The framework is generally applied but one material conflict or later-period item is insufficiently labeled.
criteria.fail_rule: The document silently treats later or conflicting material as the FY2023 position.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not use FY2024 facts as FY2023 facts or silently reconcile conflicts.

criteria.atomic_claim: Freshworks Inc. is identified as the US parent, a Delaware corporation, publicly listed on Nasdaq, with the evidenced headquarters history stated with its correct time scope.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: State the legal identity and public-company facts, and date any headquarters-history statement.
source: FY2023 Form 10-K cover, business section, and corporate information
criteria.time_scope: FY2023; historical facts dated as applicable
criteria.pass_rule: The parent, Delaware status, Nasdaq listing, and supported headquarters history are correctly stated.
criteria.partial_rule: The legal parent and public-company facts are correct but a secondary identifier or historical detail is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The parent, incorporation, listing, or headquarters history is materially misstated.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not infer a headquarters date or ticker if the supplied source does not establish it.

criteria.atomic_claim: The FY2023 perimeter contains 11 subsidiaries in 9 jurisdictions and excludes the June 2024 Device42 entities.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: State the count and jurisdictions and expressly exclude Device42 from FY2023 while identifying June 2024 as later context if mentioned.
criteria.time_scope: FY2023; June 2024 only as later context
criteria.pass_rule: The count, jurisdictional perimeter, and Device42 exclusion are correct.
criteria.partial_rule: The count and exclusion are correct but one perimeter explanation is incomplete.
criteria.fail_rule: Device42 is included in FY2023 or the perimeter count is materially wrong.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not treat June 2024 Device42 entities as FY2023 subsidiaries.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document identifies the relevant ownership relationships and entity list, including the indirect Indian holding structure where evidenced.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use the supplied ownership and subsidiary sources and flag any source mismatch for confirmation.
criteria.pass_rule: The entity list and ownership relationships are materially complete and correctly qualified.
criteria.partial_rule: The main entities and ownership are correct but one non-critical relationship or jurisdiction detail is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: A material entity or ownership relationship is wrong or omitted in a way that changes the perimeter.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert direct ownership, economic ownership, or entity status that the sources do not establish.

criteria.atomic_claim: Freshworks Technologies Private Limited is identified as an Indian operating entity, directly held as evidenced, with its incorporation date and workforce role correctly described.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Distinguish direct ownership from indirect ownership and describe India as the contract R&D/software-development and support provider.
criteria.pass_rule: The entity, ownership, date, and operating role are correctly presented.
criteria.partial_rule: The entity and role are correct but a secondary date or ownership detail is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: India is misidentified as the group parent, residual entrepreneur, or materially wrong owner.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert non-US economic IP ownership or unsupported direct holdings.

criteria.atomic_claim: Framebench, Sassist, and Osmnez are described with their evidenced acquisition, incorporation, dormant, or operational status and dates.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Report entity-specific chronology without treating acquisition context as a FY2023 change unless the source supports that conclusion.
criteria.pass_rule: The material status and chronology for each entity are correct or properly qualified.
criteria.partial_rule: The entities are identified but one status or date is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The document attributes a materially wrong status, acquisition, or operational role.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not convert a dormant or acquired entity into an operating entity without evidence.

criteria.atomic_claim: The UK, German, French, Dutch, and Natero entities are assigned their evidenced functions, headcount facts, and conflicts, including UK FY2023 average headcount of 100 and Natero Ireland FY2023 average headcount of 2.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use FY2023 accounts and controlling headcount sources; identify GmbH and Natero discrepancies instead of silently choosing a value.
source: FY2023 entity accounts for UK, Germany, France, Netherlands, and Natero Ireland
criteria.pass_rule: The material regional roles and controlling headcount facts are correct, and conflicts are stated.
criteria.partial_rule: The main roles and headcounts are correct but one conflict or secondary role is incompletely documented.
criteria.fail_rule: FY2023 headcount or entity role is materially wrong or a known conflict is silently reconciled.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not use the FY2024 Natero chart as FY2023 headcount or role evidence.

criteria.atomic_claim: Australia and Singapore are treated as limited-risk commercial entities only to the extent evidenced; missing FY2023 FTE data is identified and later interview/chart material is dated and attributed.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use cautious role descriptions, mark missing headcount as not evidenced, and ask management or Group Tax to confirm.
criteria.time_scope: FY2023 with FY2024 later context clearly marked
criteria.pass_rule: The document does not invent FTE data and clearly separates later context from FY2023.
criteria.partial_rule: The treatment is cautious but one later-period attribution or follow-up owner is missing.
criteria.fail_rule: The document states unsupported Australia or Singapore FY2023 FTE or presents later roles as FY2023 facts.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert Australia/Singapore headcount or FY2023 functions from source silence.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document states the evidenced FY2023 entity changes and does not assert that there were no restructurings or entity changes merely because the supplied sources are silent.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use not evidenced or confirm-with-management language where the record does not establish a negative.
criteria.time_scope: FY2023; FY2024 chart only as later context
criteria.pass_rule: Known changes are stated and unsupported absence is qualified.
criteria.partial_rule: The document avoids a false absolute but omits one known change or follow-up.
criteria.fail_rule: The document makes an absolute no-change/no-restructuring assertion unsupported by the record.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not turn source silence into proof that no entity change occurred.

criteria.atomic_claim: Freshworks Inc. is identified as the strategic decision-maker and the document accurately describes the evidenced senior leadership and reporting centralization without claiming unsupported completeness.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Name only supported roles and state that operating subsidiaries report to the US CEO only if the source supports it; otherwise qualify.
criteria.time_scope: FY2023; later chart dated if used
criteria.pass_rule: The parent’s strategic role and supported leadership structure are clear and properly qualified.
criteria.partial_rule: The parent’s role is correct but leadership completeness or reporting-line wording is incomplete.
criteria.fail_rule: A subsidiary or non-US entity is incorrectly described as the strategic decision-maker.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert that all subsidiaries report to a named executive unless evidenced.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document reports approximately 4,900 employees for the group and distinguishes the later 4,100 India employees, 84% India share, and 2,000 product-and-engineering figure when those later figures are mentioned.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use FY2023 headcount as controlling and label later workforce figures as later context.
criteria.time_scope: FY2023; later figures dated and attributed
criteria.pass_rule: The FY2023 group figure is correct and later workforce data is not presented as FY2023.
criteria.partial_rule: The FY2023 figure is correct but one later-period qualifier is incomplete.
criteria.fail_rule: A later workforce figure replaces or contradicts the FY2023 controlling figure without qualification.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not use FY2024 workforce figures as FY2023 headcount.

criteria.atomic_claim: Freshworks is described as a cloud-based SaaS business with the evidenced product categories and platform model.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Describe the products and SaaS model using the supplied company materials.
criteria.pass_rule: The SaaS model and principal product categories are correctly stated.
criteria.partial_rule: The SaaS model is correct but one supported product-category detail is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The business is described as a physical-goods or non-SaaS business.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not add a product name or platform feature not supported by the supplied sources.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document reports the supported customer metrics, including 67,100 customers, 2,497 customers above USD 5,000 ARR, and 108% net dollar retention; the 31% increase from 1,908 ARR customers is included only if evidenced.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: State the supported FY2023 customer metrics and do not invent omitted comparative calculations.
source: FY2023 Form 10-K business and metrics sections
criteria.pass_rule: The core FY2023 metrics are correct and any comparative metric used is sourced.
criteria.partial_rule: The core metrics are correct but one supported comparative detail is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: A customer metric is materially wrong or an unsupported comparative is asserted.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not infer a percentage increase without the source basis.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document describes the cloud-native, multi-tenant, AWS-hosted architecture and lists AWS regions only where the supplied sources support the specific list.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Separate the established hosting model from any unverified regional deployment detail.
criteria.pass_rule: The established hosting model is correct and no unsupported regional list is asserted.
criteria.partial_rule: The hosting model is correct but a supported regional detail is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The document asserts a materially unsupported hosting or regional architecture.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not invent an AWS region list.

criteria.atomic_claim: Freshworks Inc. is the principal, strategic decision-maker, legal and economic IP owner, and residual-return recipient, and controls the customer-contracting and platform strategy facts supported by the record.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: State the principal and residual profile and distinguish legal/economic ownership from local execution.
criteria.pass_rule: The principal, decision-making, IP ownership, and residual-return role are consistently stated.
criteria.partial_rule: The principal role is correct but one element or customer-contracting detail is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: India or a local commercial entity is described as the residual entrepreneur or economic IP owner.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assign non-US economic IP ownership without evidence.

criteria.atomic_claim: The value chain is described as digital SaaS development, platform operation, sales, support, and back-office services, with production treated as software activity rather than physical manufacturing.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Explain the digital value chain and the meaning of production in this SaaS context.
criteria.pass_rule: The digital value chain and non-physical production characterization are clear.
criteria.partial_rule: The value chain is correct but one digital function or explanation is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The document describes physical production, inventory, or distribution as part of the business.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert physical goods or manufacturing.

criteria.atomic_claim: India is the contract R&D/software-development and support provider, with no unsupported assertion that India owns the platform or performs other product-development functions outside the evidenced scope.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Describe India’s functions and limited-risk/service-provider profile with the required qualifications.
criteria.pass_rule: India’s contract R&D/software-development and support role is correctly stated and ownership remains with Freshworks Inc.
criteria.partial_rule: The India role is correct but one scope limitation is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: India is described as the IP owner, principal, or residual entrepreneur.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert non-US economic IP ownership or unsupported product-development functions.

criteria.atomic_claim: Local commercial entities are described as limited-risk, cost-plus service providers to the extent supported, with local market activity distinguished from entrepreneurial control.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use the entity-specific role and risk evidence and qualify unsupported local details.
criteria.pass_rule: The local commercial profile and limited-risk characterization are materially correct.
criteria.partial_rule: The characterization is correct but one local function or risk is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: A local commercial entity is described as the group principal without evidence.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not convert a service-provider characterization into a legal or economic ownership conclusion.

criteria.atomic_claim: The functional and risk matrix accurately allocates development, support, sales, marketing, contracting, credit, product, and operational risks among Freshworks Inc., India, local commercial entities, and the back-office centre, allowing nuanced limited/significant execution labels.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Preserve the table but use evidence-supported nuanced allocations rather than forcing every function into binary performed/not performed language.
criteria.pass_rule: The matrix is materially complete and consistent with the narrative, including nuanced execution and risk labels.
criteria.partial_rule: The matrix is generally correct but omits one material function or uses an unclear allocation.
criteria.fail_rule: The matrix reverses principal/service-provider roles or assigns material risks contrary to the evidence.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not impose categorical risk ownership where the evidence supports only limited execution or limited risk.

criteria.atomic_claim: Customer support or after-sales support appears as a distinguishable function in the functional matrix, or the matrix clearly cross-references the narrative support analysis.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Show support in the matrix or expressly link the matrix to the detailed support discussion.
criteria.pass_rule: Support is separately visible or clearly cross-referenced in the matrix.
criteria.partial_rule: Support is present only through an understandable combined row or cross-reference.
criteria.fail_rule: Support is discussed only in narrative with no matrix treatment or clear cross-reference.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not imply a dedicated support row exists when it does not.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document identifies the supported technology value drivers, including software, algorithms, Freddy AI, know-how, and any evidenced machine-learning or training-data components.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: State supported value drivers and label any analytical inference as such; do not invent technical details.
source: FY2023 Form 10-K product and technology sections
criteria.pass_rule: The supported software and AI value drivers are identified without unsupported technical specificity.
criteria.partial_rule: The main software/AI value drivers are identified but a supported secondary detail is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The document attributes unsupported technical assets or excludes the evidenced platform value drivers.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not invent ML models, training data, or technical ownership facts.

criteria.atomic_claim: The FY2023 patent position is stated with its correct time scope, and any FY2024 IP register or later patent figures are clearly labeled as later context.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Separate the FY2023 Form 10-K patent figures from FY2024 later materials.
criteria.pass_rule: FY2023 patent figures are correct and later figures are dated if used.
criteria.partial_rule: The FY2023 position is correct but the later context label is incomplete.
criteria.fail_rule: FY2024 IP figures are presented as FY2023 facts.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not use FY2024 patents or applications as FY2023 counts.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document identifies the evidenced IP categories and states Freshworks Inc. as legal and economic owner, while treating unsupported categories or technical details as not evidenced.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: List supported patents, software, trademarks, know-how, algorithms, and other evidenced categories; qualify domains, models, and training data if not source-supported.
criteria.pass_rule: The supported categories and US ownership are correct and unsupported detail is qualified.
criteria.partial_rule: The principal categories and ownership are correct but a supported category is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: A non-US entity is assigned economic ownership or a material category is materially misstated.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert non-US economic IP ownership or unsupported legal title.

criteria.atomic_claim: The DEMPE analysis describes Freshworks Inc. as directing and controlling relevant development and owning the economic return, while India performs contract development/support under a work-for-hire or equivalent service framework where evidenced.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Distinguish employee/service execution from control, funding, legal ownership, and economic ownership.
criteria.pass_rule: The DEMPE and work-for-hire allocation is complete and consistent with the principal/service-provider model.
criteria.partial_rule: The allocation is directionally correct but one control, funding, or agreement detail is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: India or another local entity is described as the economic owner or controller without evidence.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not equate development execution with economic ownership.

criteria.atomic_claim: Customer relationships and related value are described as mixed or context-dependent rather than automatically assigned to a single entity.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: State the source-supported customer-relationship analysis and distinguish contract ownership from local market activity.
criteria.pass_rule: The document states the supported customer-relationship treatment and labels analytical inferences.
criteria.partial_rule: The document is cautious but omits one material nuance.
criteria.fail_rule: The document assigns all customer-relationship value to a local entity without evidence.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not treat local sales activity as proof of economic ownership.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document addresses goodwill, material IP transfers, acquisition timing, and standing assignment or work-for-hire concepts without asserting an undocumented transfer.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use the supplied acquisition and IP materials and flag missing transfer documentation.
criteria.pass_rule: The document states what is evidenced and qualifies any unproven absence or transfer.
criteria.partial_rule: The main treatment is correct but one historical or agreement detail is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The document asserts a transfer, absence, or goodwill conclusion contrary to the record.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not state that no transfer occurred solely because no document was supplied.

criteria.atomic_claim: The contract R&D arrangement is described, but missing executed agreements, licence terms, or other formal terms are identified for Group Legal or management confirmation.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Describe the operating arrangement and explicitly distinguish a referenced agreement from an executed agreement reviewed.
criteria.pass_rule: The R&D arrangement is stated and missing formal terms are flagged without invention.
criteria.partial_rule: The arrangement is correct but one missing-term follow-up is not identified.
criteria.fail_rule: The document invents agreement terms or represents an unreviewed agreement as confirmed.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not invent scope, duration, termination, indemnity, or licence terms.

criteria.atomic_claim: Trademark licensing or use is described, and missing executed trademark licence terms are identified without asserting a confirmed royalty rate.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Separate observed trademark use from the legal terms and rate of any licence.
criteria.pass_rule: The document describes the evidenced trademark position and flags missing terms.
criteria.partial_rule: The trademark position is correct but one agreement or terms gap is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The document asserts a confirmed royalty rate or licence term not in the sources.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not state a confirmed royalty rate.

criteria.atomic_claim: The conflicting royalty descriptions are identified, the unresolved issue is assigned to Group Tax or Group Legal, and no royalty rate is confirmed without evidence.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Present the conflict as a conflict and state the required confirmation.
criteria.pass_rule: The conflict and follow-up are explicit and no unsupported rate is adopted.
criteria.partial_rule: The conflict is mentioned but the owner or required resolution is unclear.
criteria.fail_rule: The document silently selects one royalty description or states an unsupported rate.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert a confirmed royalty rate, fee, or final licence characterization.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document states an arm’s-length policy, central Group Tax oversight, annual review, and the applicable OECD guidance without asserting a conclusion beyond the supplied analyses.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Describe the policy framework, review process, and evidence basis.
criteria.pass_rule: Policy, oversight, review, and guidance are stated accurately.
criteria.partial_rule: The core policy is correct but one governance or guidance detail is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The document attributes an unsupported policy or review conclusion.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not state that a policy or study proves arm’s-length pricing without the required qualifications.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document describes the regional benchmark coverage, including the 11 studies and the number of comparables only where the supplied benchmark source establishes it.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: State the benchmark scope and distinguish study count, tested-party analysis, and comparable-company count.
criteria.time_scope: FY2023 policy context; study periods as cited
criteria.pass_rule: The regional study scope is correctly described and no unsupported comparable count is asserted.
criteria.partial_rule: The study scope and range are correct but a supported count or scope detail is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The document materially misstates the benchmark universe or uses an unsupported count as fact.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not invent the number of comparable companies.

criteria.atomic_claim: For each material transaction category, the document states the TNMM or Full Cost Mark-Up method and identifies the appropriate tested party, consistently with the principal/service-provider model.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use a transaction-level table or equivalent narrative covering R&D, support, back-office, local commercial services, and any other evidenced category.
criteria.pass_rule: Each material transaction has a method and tested party, and the selection is consistent with the functions and risks.
criteria.partial_rule: The core method and tested-party selections are correct but one material transaction is incomplete.
criteria.fail_rule: The method or tested party is materially missing or assigned to the wrong entrepreneurial entity.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not treat a party as tested merely because it performs some activity; the selection must follow the functional analysis.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document treats goods, manufacturing, inventory, distribution, cost contribution arrangements, and pass-through costs only to the extent supported, with SaaS physical-goods rows marked not applicable.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use N/A or not evidenced where appropriate and do not invent a CCA or goods transaction.
criteria.pass_rule: The document correctly treats unsupported goods/CCA matters as N/A or not evidenced.
criteria.partial_rule: The document is cautious but one pass-through or CCA follow-up is not addressed.
criteria.fail_rule: The document asserts a goods transaction, manufacturing, inventory, physical distribution, or CCA without support.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert physical goods or a cost contribution arrangement.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document states the India 15% markup, the Asia-Pacific benchmark interquartile range of 8.34%–10.37% and median of 9.32% where relevant, and presents the difference as an inconsistency requiring Group Tax attention.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Do not silently reconcile the difference; state the conflict and owner.
criteria.time_scope: FY2023 pricing; benchmark period as cited
criteria.pass_rule: Both figures and the unresolved Group Tax issue are stated accurately.
criteria.partial_rule: The figures are correct but the inconsistency or follow-up is not explicit.
criteria.fail_rule: The document omits the conflict or asserts that 15% falls within the cited range.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not claim the India markup is benchmark-consistent when the cited range is 8.34%–10.37%.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document distinguishes the residual return to Freshworks Inc. from any low-value-added-services discussion and states that no LVAS election or simplification is evidenced.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use absence-qualified language and do not imply a formal election.
criteria.pass_rule: Residual return and LVAS status are correctly separated and qualified.
criteria.partial_rule: The concepts are separated but the absence/election qualification is incomplete.
criteria.fail_rule: The document asserts an LVAS election or assigns the residual return to a service provider.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert a confirmed LVAS election.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document explains service compensation, cost-plus mechanics, agreement coverage, and the annual transaction flow without inventing missing formal terms.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Cross-reference the transaction table, agreement register, and open questions.
criteria.pass_rule: The compensation model and material agreement gaps are clear.
criteria.partial_rule: The compensation model is correct but one agreement or flow detail is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The document invents a rate, term, or transaction flow.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not fill missing agreement or licence terms by inference.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document describes parent-level capital, the September 2021 IPO and approximately USD 1.1 billion net proceeds, and treats any 'only public offering' wording as a qualified source-based statement.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: State the evidenced public offering and avoid turning source silence into an absolute absence of any other offering.
source: FY2023 Form 10-K financing and capital sections
criteria.pass_rule: The 2021 offering and proceeds are correctly stated and any exclusivity wording is properly qualified.
criteria.partial_rule: The event and proceeds are correct but an exclusivity qualification is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The document states a materially wrong offering, proceeds, or public-capital history.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert 'only public offering' as an absolute fact unless the supplied source expressly establishes it.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document accurately states that no external debt or facilities are identified in the supplied FY2023 financial statements only as a source-limited observation and asks for confirmation of any facilities or credit commitments.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use not identified/not evidenced language and identify the Group Treasury or management follow-up.
source: FY2023 Form 10-K balance sheet and liquidity sections
criteria.pass_rule: The document uses source-limited wording and does not assert absolute absence.
criteria.partial_rule: The wording is cautious but the facilities follow-up is incomplete.
criteria.fail_rule: The document asserts that the group had no external debt or facilities as an established absolute fact.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not convert an unshown balance-sheet caption into proof that no facilities existed.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document distinguishes USD 488.1 million cash and USD 699.5 million securities, identifies the USD 1.19 billion total, notes the conflicting USD 1.07 billion figure, and does not silently adopt unsupported liability or deferred-revenue amounts.

source: FY2023 Form 10-K balance sheet and notes

criteria.pass_rule: The cash/investment figures and conflict are correctly stated and unsupported liability claims are qualified.
criteria.partial_rule: The cash conflict is correctly handled but one supporting liability or deferred-revenue detail is omitted.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document reports supported share counts and equity-compensation figures and treats any causal explanation for the change from 289.1 million to 296.7 million RSU/ESPP-related shares as an inference unless the source establishes it.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use the 10-K figures and clearly qualify any explanation for the movement.
source: FY2023 Form 10-K equity and share-based compensation notes
criteria.pass_rule: The relevant figures are correct and causal explanations are qualified.
criteria.partial_rule: The document is directionally correct but omits one supported share count or uses an incomplete qualification.
criteria.fail_rule: The document invents a causal explanation or materially misstates the equity figures.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not attribute the RSU/ESPP movement to a specific cause without source support.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document addresses cash-pool consideration, no documented implementation of cash pooling or netting, captive insurance, and forward exchange contracts with source-limited wording and follow-up where data is missing.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Separate consideration from implementation and do not state absence beyond the evidence.
criteria.pass_rule: The document states the evidenced treasury position and qualifies missing data.
criteria.partial_rule: The main treasury position is correct but one item, such as forward contracts, is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The document asserts an implemented pool, netting, captive insurance, or unsupported derivatives position.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert cash pooling, netting, captive insurance, or forward contracts without evidence.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document reconciles the nil loan register with later interview evidence of possible intercompany loans, states the later reference-rate-plus-spread policy and 100–200 bps range only as later context, and asks Group Treasury to confirm balances, terms, and lender basis.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Identify the conflict and do not invent loan balances, terms, interest, or independent-bank-lender support.
criteria.time_scope: FY2023; later policy/interview material clearly dated
criteria.pass_rule: The conflict, later policy, and confirmation requirements are explicit.
criteria.partial_rule: The conflict is identified but one term, balance, or independent-lender follow-up is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The document adopts unsupported loan terms, balances, or interest conclusions as FY2023 facts.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert outstanding loans, rates, maturities, or lender comparability without evidence.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document asks Group Treasury, Group Legal, or management to confirm guarantees, letters of credit, surety, insurance, and related support where the sources do not establish a programme.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use not documented/not evidenced and open-question language rather than a categorical absence.
criteria.pass_rule: The relevant support items are addressed as evidence permits and missing confirmations are assigned.
criteria.partial_rule: The document flags the general gap but omits one material item or owner.
criteria.fail_rule: The document asserts a guarantee programme, no guarantees, or captive insurance without evidence.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert a guarantee programme or categorical absence of guarantees.

criteria.atomic_claim: The financial tables use the FY2023 Form 10-K and FY2023 entity accounts as controlling for FY2021–FY2023 audited figures, including FY2023 revenue of USD 596.4 million and FY2022 revenue of USD 498.0 million.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Reconcile totals and identify any non-controlling later figures separately.
criteria.pass_rule: The financial tables and key revenue figures agree with the controlling sources.
criteria.partial_rule: The main figures are correct but one table total, comparison, or source attribution is incomplete.
criteria.fail_rule: A controlling audited figure is materially wrong or replaced by a later-period figure.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not use later material to replace audited FY2023 financials.

criteria.atomic_claim: The narrative addresses revenue growth, FY2022 revenue where relevant, share-based compensation of approximately USD 210.707 million or 35%, interest income, and tax provision with cautious jurisdictional wording.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use the 10-K narrative and do not overstate the location or cause of tax expense.
criteria.pass_rule: The financial-performance narrative is accurate and properly qualified.
criteria.partial_rule: The main narrative is correct but one supported figure or cautious tax qualification is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The narrative materially misstates revenue, SBC, interest, or tax provision.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert an exclusively foreign tax provision when the source includes US and foreign jurisdictions.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document states that Freshworks reports a single operating segment and that a complete segmental P&L by entity or jurisdiction is not available in the supplied materials.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Distinguish public segment reporting from internal entity-level profitability.
criteria.pass_rule: Single-segment reporting and the missing internal segmental P&L are both correctly addressed.
criteria.partial_rule: Single-segment reporting is correct but the internal P&L gap is not clearly stated.
criteria.fail_rule: The document fabricates a segmental P&L or states that none exists as an absolute unsupported fact.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not treat public single-segment reporting as proof that internal entity P&Ls do not exist.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document states the evidenced APA status and identifies any missing executed APA or implementation details for Group Tax confirmation.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Distinguish an APA reference, application, or discussion from an executed and effective APA.
criteria.pass_rule: The APA status is accurately stated and gaps are flagged.
criteria.partial_rule: The status is directionally correct but one missing confirmation is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The document asserts an executed or effective APA without evidence.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert an APA outcome or coverage not established by the supplied record.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document addresses CbCR thresholds, notifications, and status, but does not assert a confirmed FY2023 CbCR filing without a filing receipt or equivalent source.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: State preliminary or not evidenced status and ask Group Tax to confirm filing and notification details.
criteria.pass_rule: The CbCR position is cautious and no filing is presented as confirmed without evidence.
criteria.partial_rule: The document avoids a false filing assertion but omits one threshold or notification detail.
criteria.fail_rule: The document states that a FY2023 CbCR was filed or accepted without evidence.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not assert a FY2023 CbCR filing.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document describes the India tax examination, MAP/dispute status, and tax-reserve or unrecognized-tax-benefit figures only where supported, including the supplied 5.6/3.6 and accrued-interest 1.4/0.8 amounts if presented.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Separate an examination from a final assessment and identify missing reserve detail rather than inventing it.
criteria.pass_rule: The examination, dispute status, and supported reserve figures are accurately stated or properly qualified.
criteria.partial_rule: The examination and dispute position are correct but reserve figures or one follow-up is omitted.
criteria.fail_rule: The document describes an examination as a final assessment or materially invents tax-reserve facts.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not state a final India liability, MAP outcome, or reserve amount not established by the sources.

criteria.atomic_claim: Material conclusions are traceable to filename plus page, section, sheet, table, or paragraph, and the document identifies source conflicts, hierarchy, unresolved items, and responsible follow-up.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Use citations or evidence references sufficient for replay and distinguish fact, inference, later context, and open question.
criteria.pass_rule: Material facts and conflicts are traceable and follow-up ownership is clear.
criteria.partial_rule: The document is generally traceable but one material section lacks a usable source reference or owner.
criteria.fail_rule: The document contains material unsupported conclusions or silently reconciles known conflicts.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not treat a generic source list as support for every individual claim.

criteria.atomic_claim: The document preserves the template’s structure and tables while rendering as a readable, self-contained DOCX with no missing text, broken tables, material overflow, blank-page artifacts, or unreadable formatting.
criteria.expected_document_treatment: Inspect the rendered document and the complete DOCX package before delivery.
criteria.pass_rule: Template structure is preserved and rendering/package QA is clean.
criteria.partial_rule: The document is usable but has a localized non-material layout or consistency defect.
criteria.fail_rule: The document has material missing text, broken tables, overflow, blank pages, or unreadable formatting.
criteria.prohibited_overstatement: Do not call the document production-ready without rendered inspection and full-package placeholder search.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: Physical goods, manufacturing, inventory, or physical distribution is presented as an applicable Freshworks activity.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only when the assertion is affirmative; N/A (SaaS), N/A (digital), or qualified absence is compliant.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: Freshworks has a confirmed cost contribution arrangement.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only on an affirmative CCA assertion; asking for confirmation is compliant.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: A royalty rate or final royalty/licence fee is confirmed without source support.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only on an unsupported affirmative rate or final characterization.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: A FY2023 CbCR was filed or accepted without evidence.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only on a confirmed filing assertion.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: The group had no external debt or facilities as an absolute FY2023 fact.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only on an absolute assertion; not identified/not evidenced and a confirmation question are compliant.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: Cash pooling, netting, captive insurance, or related treasury arrangements are confirmed without evidence.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only on unsupported implementation or categorical absence.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: A group guarantee programme or categorical absence of guarantees is asserted without evidence.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only on unsupported affirmative or absolute-negative language.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: Unsupported intercompany loan balances, interest, maturities, rates, or terms are stated as FY2023 facts.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only when the document adopts the disputed or later loan material as established FY2023 fact.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: A non-US entity is assigned economic ownership of Freshworks platform IP without evidence.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only on an affirmative non-US economic ownership conclusion.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: FY2024 headcount, IP, organization-chart, or functional-analysis facts are presented as the FY2023 position.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only when the later-period label is absent or contradicted.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: Freshworks made a confirmed LVAS election or simplification election without evidence.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only on an affirmative unsupported election statement.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: June 2024 Device42 entities are included in the FY2023 perimeter.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only if Device42 is treated as a FY2023 group entity.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: The September 2021 IPO is asserted to be the only public offering as an absolute fact without source support.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only on unsupported exclusivity wording.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: Later or non-controlling figures replace FY2023 Form 10-K or entity-account financials.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only on a material conflict resolved against the controlling FY2023 sources without qualification.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: Unsupported Australia or Singapore FY2023 FTE figures are asserted.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only on an affirmative unsupported FTE figure.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: An unreconciled ledger or later schedule is treated as authoritative over the controlling FY2023 accounts.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only on a material unsupported hierarchy reversal.

guardrails.prohibited_assertion: Source silence is converted into an absolute negative, including no restructuring, no facilities, no guarantees, no other offering, or no internal P&L.
guardrails.detection_rule: Trigger only on an absolute negative that the supplied sources cannot establish; qualified not evidenced language is compliant.

crosswalk_policy.method: Each criterion.source_rids and guardrail.source_rids is the authoritative crosswalk. An original R-ID may map to more than one new item where it contains both a positive claim and a guardrail.
crosswalk_policy.coverage_requirement: Every original R-ID in the supplied rubric, including lettered variants, must appear in at least one source_rids array.

known_tension_resolutions.R-105/R-148: R-105 is a qualified financial-statement observation under F-02; R-148 is a guardrail against adopting unsupported loan conclusions under F-06/G-08.
known_tension_resolutions.R-107: Later-period loan policy may earn only later-context credit and cannot establish FY2023 loan balances or terms.
known_tension_resolutions.R-110: Absolute liability wording is rejected; F-03 requires source-specific and qualified treatment.
known_tension_resolutions.R-114: The share/RSU movement may be reported, but a causal explanation must be labeled as inference or omitted.
known_tension_resolutions.R-115b/R-117/R-146/R-152: Absence is not required; qualified not documented/not evidenced/confirm language passes. Unsupported affirmative or absolute-negative assertions trigger only the relevant guardrail.
known_tension_resolutions.R-154/R-160: The IPO date and proceeds are positive facts; only public offering is treated as a qualified proposition, not an absolute requirement.
known_tension_resolutions.R-024: No restructuring or entity-change conclusion must be qualified unless affirmatively evidenced.
known_tension_resolutions.R-026: Parent strategic centralization earns credit without requiring an unsupported statement that every subsidiary reports to one named executive.
known_tension_resolutions.R-033: FY2024 organization-chart material is later context only and cannot establish FY2023 roles or headcount.
known_tension_resolutions.R-133: CbCR threshold/status treatment is positive; a confirmed FY2023 filing is a separate prohibited assertion.
known_tension_resolutions.R-150: FY2024 headcount, IP, and functional material must be dated and attributed and may not replace the FY2023 position.

validation.required_original_rid_coverage: R-001 through R-161, including all lettered variants appearing in the current rubric
required_checks: all original rubric IDs are covered
no raw unweighted checklist score is reported
